title: Find NULL Values
description: Write a query to find all students who have a NULL phone number.
hints: Use IS NULL to check for NULL
solutionSql: SELECT * FROM students WHERE phone IS NULL;
explanation: NULL represents missing or unknown values. Use IS NULL to check for them.

title: Find Non-NULL Values
description: Write a query to find all students who have a non-NULL phone number.
solutionSql: SELECT * FROM students WHERE phone IS NOT NULL;
explanation: IS NOT NULL checks for values that are present (not missing).

title: NULL Comparison
description: How do you check if a value is NULL in SQL?
explanation: NULL cannot be compared with = or !=. Must use IS NULL or IS NOT NULL.

title: Replace NULL with Default
description: Write a query to show student names, replacing NULL phone with 'N/A'.
solutionSql: SELECT name, COALESCE(phone, 'N/A') as phone FROM students;
explanation: COALESCE() returns the first non-NULL value from its arguments.

title: Fix NULL Query
description: This query has an error. Fix it: SELECT * FROM students WHERE phone = NULL;
solutionSql: SELECT * FROM students WHERE phone IS NULL;
explanation: NULL comparisons must use IS NULL, not = NULL, because NULL represents unknown.
brokenQuery: SELECT * FROM students WHERE phone = NULL;

title: Complete NULL Check
description: Complete the query to find records with missing email: SELECT * FROM students WHERE email ___ NULL;
solutionSql: SELECT * FROM students WHERE email IS NULL;
explanation: IS NULL is the correct syntax for checking NULL values.
blankTemplate: SELECT * FROM students WHERE email ___ NULL;

title: Predict NULL Behavior
description: What will this query return? SELECT COUNT(phone) FROM students;
explanation: COUNT(column) counts non-NULL values only. It excludes NULL entries.
